snippet.title: Killest Fights CRAW-Mech Trailer
snippet.description:
Here Comes Killest...

Steam Page (Out Now!)- https://store.steampowered.com/app/4500410/Killest_Fights_CRAWMech/

Killest Fights CRAW-Mech Soundtrack- https://soundcloud.com/fil2-dev-shared/sets/killest-fights-craw-mech

Trailer Full Theme- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U8AZOSG2jV4

Killest Fights CRAW-Mech is a turn based sci-fi RPG about Killest, a cyborg who was once a famous scientist, taking his revenge on the RDA (Robot Destruction Agency). Rampage through a robot-filled base, push around a weak-willed supervisor, hopefully run into no barrel puzzles, and face your past head first in this epic onslaught...

Trailer Credits~
